name: Keeping Faith
overview: Scripture teaches that keeping faith involves fully trusting in the Lord rather than relying on our own understanding, as Proverbs 3:5 encourages. Faith is the means by which we are justified and find peace with God through Jesus Christ (Romans 5:1), and it grows by hearing the Word of God (Romans 10:17). Jesus emphasizes that even faith as small as a mustard seed can overcome great obstacles (Matthew 17:20), while Jeremiah 33:3 assures us that calling on God leads to His revealing mighty and hidden things. Galatians 6:9 exhorts believers to persevere in doing good, promising a harvest if we do not give up, highlighting the steadfastness required to keep faith alive.
